caption: The drawing shows a metallic pitcher with a large, rounded base and a slightly narrower neck, rendered in shades of gray with white highlights to indicate light reflection and texture. The pitcher has a curved spout on the left side, with a section of small circular holes near its edge, suggesting a built-in strainer. The handle is attached on the right side and extends upward and outward. Resting on the top edge of the pitcher is a matching lid, also rendered in gray, with concentric circular ridges and a knob for lifting. The objects are centered within a simple rectangular border, positioned on a cream-colored background with faint lines drawn to suggest the surface on which the pitcher sits.
title: Silver Teapot
